title: 200 Hz achieved — and the robot got worse
question: Does running the policy at its design rate of 200 Hz improve it?
headline: The opposite: pitch RMS 2.43 -> 8.06 deg and it fell at 5.5 s where the 69 Hz version survived 10. Two explanations were live and this run could not separate them — the ~11 Hz resonance, or a battery at 7918 mV against 8340-8472 for the baseline, with clamping at 22%.
hub_output: forward pass: 1565 us of a 5000 us budget
